name: Trace disjoint drawing-group evaluation

selection.procedure: Deterministic source/type/language round-robin; grouped by building/model/project; no expected values used for selection.

scoring.counts: Exact integral value; no rounding or tolerance.
scoring.units: Explicit compatible units required for measurements; convertible SI/imperial units are normalized. A missing unit is allowed only for counts.
scoring.text: Manual review only; excluded from automatic accuracy denominators.
scoring.answered: Numeric value supplied or nonempty free-text answer, unless an explicit abstention/error status. needs_review numeric values are provisional answers and remain in accuracy denominators.

evaluation_limits: This stratified diagnostic sample deliberately oversamples rare task types; its percentage is not an estimate of full-dataset or competition accuracy.
Preview labels may themselves contain ambiguity or errors; results compare with supplied labels, not independent engineering ground truth.

Geometry checks validate finite normalized coordinates, nondegenerate shapes, pages and IDs only. They do not verify cited content, count completeness, actual source alignment, or semantic correctness.
Unprojected native IFC source IDs are legitimate evidence references but cannot count as 2D highlight coverage.
All gold labels remain exclusively in evaluator/config/report files and are never included in inference requests.
Auto/vision execution requires explicit operator opt-in and is capped at five questions per invocation; native is the zero-API default.
This sample is disjoint from explicitly excluded diagnostic groups, not proof that a developer has never seen these drawings.
Round-robin stratification oversamples rare types. Report per-source results; do not present this as a naturally weighted competition score.
Preserve this manifest unchanged after scoring; use fresh excluded groups for an independent final holdout.
